0 findings; 0 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

I found nothing to flag in the three files. The new `markRecordTiming` calls use imports that exist in each file. In both `record-timing.ts` modules, a mark does nothing when no timeline is open, so the added stop and cancel marks stay quiet outside a recording. Every `abandonCountdownRegion` call site now passes a reason. The two window `unresponsive` and `responsive` handlers use `console.warn` directly, so they print even when no timeline is open, which is what their comment says they are for. I did not run the code or any tests.
